messages:
lee_infra: heads up — we have a vendor planned single-fiber swap in us-west2 on Tue 03:00–06:00 UTC. Network team expects a brief cutover per rack; I'm proposing a controlled handover of GPU cohorts across regions to avoid inflight failures.

samir: short question — do we need full node drains or can we soft-evict GPU tasks and let jobs respawn elsewhere?

lee_infra: plan is soft drain + cordon for affected racks, full `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` only for nodes that show link flapping. aim is <10% of capacity impacted at a time.

tia_ops: customer comms? any Dedicated pools affected (SLA customers)? we should send targeted notice.

lee_infra: Dedicated: two small pools in us-west2 are on the shortlist. they’re reserved but not pinned to host racks — we'll failover into reserved burst first, then regional fallback. sending draft comms in #customer-success in 15m.

noah: ops note — KV cache will cold-start when we shift traffic. recommend seeding top prefixes for common tenants before cutover. I can run warmup jobs ~30m prior.

samir: what about model routing fallback? if capacity spikes, we should automatically route traffic to cheaper compatible quantized variants to avoid timeouts. inc config?

lee_infra: yes — routing policy: priority -> hosted small-quant -> dedicated fallback. will add emergency policy: `max_latency_ms: 1200` trigger to redirect.

ops-bot: scheduled_maint: Vendor fiber swap (us-west2) created by neteng, window 1778884444–1778886244.

tia_ops: cost impact estimate? if all overflow hits on-demand in other regions, ops team wants an upper bound.

noah: rough calc: expected 1500 concurrent tokens/s shift for ~2h peak. ballpark added cost = ~"$9k–$18k" depending on batching efficiency and cross-region egress. will refine after warmup results.

lee_infra: mitigation checklist:
- pre-seed KV/prefix cache (noah)
- pre-warm standby cohorts in eu-west1 (samir)
- set routing fallback thresholds (lee_infra)
- customer comms draft (tia_ops)
- on-call rota: lee, samir, noah 03:00–07:00 UTC

samir: I’ll stage the cohort warmers and monitor tail-latency dashboards. will post quick runbook with `kubectl` snippets.

noah: runbook snippet for warmup:```bash
# seed top prefixes for tenant-42
python tools/kv_warmup.py --tenant tenant-42 --model redwood-3b --top-prefixes 2000
```

lee_infra: thanks — if anyone sees persistent packet-loss during cutover, abort handover and fall back to cross-region routing only. will update thread with final approved window and comms link. :white_check_mark:
